com.tle.beans.entity.itemdef.SummarySect.configuration:
<xml><markup><#assign eqserver = "${attributes.get('xfer/eqserver')}">
<#if xml.get('item/itembody/keywords/keyword') != ''>
<div class="displayNodeFull">
<h3>Keywords</h3>
<p>
<#list xml.getAll('item/itembody/keywords/keyword') as kw>
	<#assign sl = "${eqserver}/access/searching.do?uc=true&sort=rank&q=${kw?replace(' ','+')}&in=all&dr=AFTER" >
	<a title="${kw}" href="${sl}">${kw}</a><#if kw_has_next>,&nbsp;</#if>
</#list>
</p>
</div>
</#if></markup><script>var x = attributes.createSubtree('xfer');
var parts = utils.getItemUrl(currentItem).split('/');
var baseUrl = parts[0] + '//' + parts[2] + '/' + parts[3];
x.set('eqserver',baseUrl);</script></xml>

<xml><markup><div class="displayNodeHalf">
<h3>Original Contributor</h3>
<p>
${xml.get('item/itembody/originalContributor/lastName')}, ${xml.get('item/itembody/originalContributor/firstName')}
</p>
</div>

<#if xml.get('item/itembody/itemRights/authors/author/firstName') != ''>
<div class="displayNodeHalf">
<h3>Content Authors</h3>
<p>
<#list xml.getAllSubtrees('item/itembody/itemRights/authors/author/') as author>
	${author.get('lastName')}, ${author.get('firstName')}<br />
</#list>
</p>
</div>
</#if>
</markup><script/></xml>
